name: Multiple-choice trivia
summary: Answer questions by picking one of four options; faster right answers score more.
core_loop: read the question → pick one of four answers before the timer → see right or wrong and points → next
win: top the leaderboard after the last question
scoring: points per correct answer, speed bonus
social_hooks: Live group trivia night: everyone answers the same question, leaderboard after each round.

name: Rare-answer trivia
summary: Type one answer to an open question; correct answers score by how rare they are.
core_loop: read prompt → type an answer before the timer → see its rarity tier and points → next prompt
rules: an answer counts if it fuzzy-matches an accepted answer
points by tier, rarest scores most
social_hooks: Compare rarity scores with friends on the same daily prompt.
example_prompts: name a country starting with M, rarer is better

name: Guess the top survey answers
summary: Guess the most popular answers to a survey question; more popular answers score more.
core_loop: read the survey question → type an answer → it lands on the board or costs a strike → clear the board
rules: each answer on the board has a share of the survey
win: clear the board or score most
scoring: points equal to the answer's survey share
social_hooks: Two teams from a Group face off; strikes pass control.
example_prompts: survey says game for a party

name: True or false blitz
summary: Swipe true or false on rapid-fire statements before time runs out.
core_loop: read a statement → swipe true or false → keep the streak going as it speeds up
social_hooks: Streak challenge sent to friends.

name: Higher or lower
summary: Guess whether the next item's number (searches, price, population) is higher or lower.
core_loop: see two items and one value → guess if the next is higher or lower → reveal → continue
social_hooks: Streak leaderboard in a group.
example_prompts: higher lower game with google searches

name: Closest guess wins
summary: Guess a number (year, height, count); closest to the real answer scores most.
core_loop: read the question → enter a number → closest guess wins the round
social_hooks: Everyone in the Group guesses; closest wins the round.
example_prompts: guess the year the movie came out

name: Put events in order
summary: Place events or inventions on a timeline in the right order.
core_loop: draw a card → place it on the timeline → reveal the year → wrong places cost a life
rules: cards must sit between earlier and later events
social_hooks: Make a timeline of your friend group's history and send it.

name: Picture reveal
summary: An image is revealed bit by bit; guess what it is as early as possible.
core_loop: the image reveals tile by tile → type a guess at any time → earlier right guesses score more
rules: one guess at a time; wrong guesses cost time
scoring: points by how early you guessed
social_hooks: Group race: earliest correct guess scores most.
example_prompts: guess the picture as it unblurs

name: Who am I clues
summary: Get clues one at a time about a person, place or thing; guess early for more points.
core_loop: read a clue → guess or ask for another → solve with as few clues as possible
rules: each new clue lowers the points
social_hooks: Write clues about yourself for friends to guess.

name: Guess where in the world
summary: See a picture or clue and place a pin on the map; closer pins score more.
core_loop: see the clue or image → drop a pin on the map → see the distance → next round
social_hooks: Same locations for the whole group; distance leaderboard.
example_prompts: guess the country from its shape

name: Flags and shapes
summary: Name the country or state from its flag or outline.
core_loop: A flag or a country or state outline appears; pick or type the place it belongs to, with streaks for consecutive right answers
social_hooks: Streak sharing.
example_prompts: name the state from its shape
notes: Shapes work today (country_outline); flags need a public-domain flag set (see docs/harness-gaps/maps.md). Shapes work today (country_outline); flags need a public-domain flag set (see docs/harness-gaps/maps.md).

name: Which came first
summary: Pick which of two things came first, is bigger, or is older.
core_loop: see two items → pick which came first or is bigger → reveal → next
social_hooks: Streak duels between two friends.
example_prompts: is the chicken older than the egg game

name: Buzz in first
summary: Questions are read out word by word; buzz in as soon as you know the answer.
core_loop: words of the question appear → buzz when you know it → type the answer before the timer
rules: a wrong buzz locks you out of that question
scoring: earlier buzzes score more; wrong buzz penalty
social_hooks: Head-to-head buzzer battles in a group.
example_prompts: buzz in when you know it

name: Category board
summary: Pick a category and point value from a board; harder questions are worth more.
core_loop: pick a category and value → answer → score or lose those points → pick again
win: most points after the board is cleared
scoring: points equal to the cell's value
social_hooks: Make a board about the group and play together.

name: Wager on your confidence
summary: Bet points on how sure you are before seeing the answer.
core_loop: see the category → bet points → answer → win or lose the bet
rules: you can't bet more than you have
social_hooks: Group wagers on each other's answers.

name: Climb the money ladder
aliases: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire
summary: Answer increasingly hard questions to climb a ladder; one miss drops you to the last safe rung.
core_loop: answer a question → climb a rung → use a lifeline if stuck → walk away or keep going
rules: a wrong answer drops you to the last safe rung
you may walk away with what you have
social_hooks: Share how high you climbed; friends try to beat it.
example_prompts: who wants to be a millionaire game

name: Last one standing
summary: Wrong answers knock you out; the last player left wins.
core_loop: everyone answers → wrong answers are out → harder questions → last one in wins
social_hooks: Group elimination night.

name: Outrun the chaser
summary: Answer to move ahead on a board while a chaser who answers better closes in.
core_loop: answer to move ahead on the board → the chaser answers to close in → reach home before being caught
rules: each right answer moves one step
social_hooks: One friend is the chaser, the others run.

name: Team relay
summary: Teammates take turns answering; each right answer passes the baton.
core_loop: your teammate answers → pass to the next → the team's track moves → race the other team
social_hooks: Two teams from a Group race each other.
example_prompts: group quiz where we take turns

name: Guess the price
summary: Guess the price of a product; closest without going over wins.
core_loop: see the item → bid a price → closest without going over wins
rules: bids over the real price lose
social_hooks: Group round: everyone bids, closest wins.

name: Name the logo
summary: Name the brand or team from a cropped or altered logo.
core_loop: See a tightly cropped or altered logo, type the brand or team, and reveal more of the logo if stuck at the cost of points
scoring: points by how little was revealed
social_hooks: Streak duels.

name: Name the movie from a frame
summary: Name the movie or show from a single frame, a frame each guess.
core_loop: see a still → type the title → each wrong guess shows another frame → solve early
social_hooks: Daily shared puzzle with group scores.
example_prompts: guess the movie from a still
name the show from a scene

name: What connects them
summary: Find what links a set of clues revealed one at a time.
core_loop: see the first clue → guess the link or ask for the next → earlier guesses score more
rules: clues come one at a time
social_hooks: Teams of two in a group.

name: What comes next
summary: Given three items in a sequence, name the fourth.
core_loop: Read three items that follow a hidden rule, type the fourth, then see the rule revealed; more clues cost points
rules: one sequence rule links the items
social_hooks: Head-to-head.
example_prompts: what comes next in the sequence

name: Name them all
summary: Name every item in a list (all 50 states, every Pixar film) before time runs out.
core_loop: type an answer → it fills its slot → keep going until the list is full or time runs out
social_hooks: Co-op mode: the group fills one list together.

name: Click the matching items
summary: Click every item in a grid that fits the category; avoid the wrong ones.
core_loop: Scan a grid of items and tap every one that fits the category while avoiding decoys, before the clock runs out
social_hooks: Score sharing.

name: Match the pairs
summary: Match each item to its partner (capital to country, actor to role).
core_loop: tap an item → tap its partner → correct pairs lock → finish the set
rules: each item has exactly one partner
social_hooks: Race friends on the same set.
example_prompts: match the capital to the country
match the actor to the character

name: Lightning round
summary: Answer as many questions as you can in 60 seconds; passing is allowed.
core_loop: read the question → answer or pass → as many as possible in 60 seconds
social_hooks: Score leaderboard for the group.

name: Real or fake headline
summary: Decide whether a headline or fact is real or made up.
core_loop: read the headline → tap real or fake → reveal the source → next
social_hooks: Friends submit headlines for the group to judge.

name: Riddle trivia
summary: Answer riddles with a short typed answer; hints cost points.
core_loop: Read a trivia riddle, type a short answer, and buy hints that cost points if stuck; the fastest clean answer scores most
social_hooks: Send riddles to friends.
example_prompts: riddle game for a road trip

name: Guess the sound
summary: Hear a sound effect and guess what made it.
core_loop: Play a short sound effect, pick or type what made it, and earn more for guessing from shorter clips
social_hooks: Party mode.

name: Trivia board game
summary: Roll and move around a board; land on a category and answer to collect wedges.
core_loop: roll → move → answer the category you land on → earn a wedge for a hub question
rules: wedges only come from hub spaces
social_hooks: Turn-based with friends.

name: Guess the group's answer
summary: Guess what percentage of the group agreed with a hot take.
core_loop: read the hot take → guess what percent of the group agreed → closest wins
social_hooks: Built on the Group's own poll answers.

name: Match the herd
summary: Everyone answers the same open question; you score if you match the most common answer.
core_loop: Everyone answers the same open question; answers are grouped, and you score for matching the most common answer in your group
rules: answers are grouped by fuzzy match
social_hooks: Group party game.
example_prompts: say the same answer as everyone

name: Lyric to artist
summary: Read a lyric and name the artist or song.
core_loop: Read an original lyric-style line written in an artist's style, type the artist or song style it echoes, and move to the next
social_hooks: Music-taste duels between friends.
example_prompts: guess the song from the lyrics

name: Guess the year
summary: See a photo, headline or song and guess the year it's from.
core_loop: See a photo, headline or song description, enter the year you think it's from, and score more the closer you land
rules: the year must be a whole number
social_hooks: Daily shared set.
example_prompts: guess what year this photo is from
guess the year from the news

name: Read the hidden word
summary: Read a word or brand that's blurred, scrambled or mirrored.
core_loop: A word or name appears blurred, scrambled or mirrored; type it as soon as you can read it while the distortion slowly clears
social_hooks: Speed race.

name: Which one are you
summary: Answer questions to be sorted into a character, house or type.
core_loop: answer a question → answers add to outcomes → see which one you are
rules: each answer weights one or more outcomes
social_hooks: Share your result and see the group's breakdown.
example_prompts: buzzfeed style which character are you

name: Trivia bingo
summary: Answers fill squares on a bingo card; get a line to win.
core_loop: a question is called → answer it → if the answer is on your card, mark it → make a line
rules: a square only counts if your answer was right
social_hooks: Group plays the same caller.

name: Daily five
summary: Five themed questions a day, same for everyone; share your score grid.
core_loop: answer five themed questions → see your share grid → post it
social_hooks: Streaks and share grids in the group chat.

name: Sports stat guess
summary: Guess the player or team from a stat line or career path.
core_loop: see a stat line → type the player or team → hints narrow it → solve
rules: hints reveal one stat at a time
social_hooks: Daily grid with rarity scores shared in the group.
example_prompts: guess the nba player from stats

name: Grid of two clues
summary: Fill a 3x3 grid where each cell's answer must satisfy its row and column clue.
core_loop: pick a cell → type an answer that fits its row and column → rarer answers score more → fill the grid
social_hooks: Rarity score compared across the group.
example_prompts: grid game with row and column clues

name: Emoji trivia
summary: Guess the movie, song or show from emojis.
core_loop: Read a string of emojis, type the movie, song or show title they describe, and take hint letters if stuck
social_hooks: Write emoji clues for friends.
example_prompts: guess the disney movie from emoji

name: Fastest finger first
summary: Put four answers in the correct order as fast as possible.
core_loop: see four items → drag them into the right order → fastest right order wins
rules: all four must be in order to count
social_hooks: Buzzer race between friends.

name: Answer, then see it on the map
aliases: shows the country on a map
trivia with the country on a map
summary: Multiple-choice trivia where every question belongs to a place; after each answer the place lights up on a real world map, so a round of sayings, foods or festivals becomes a little trip around the world.
core_loop: read the question → pick an answer → the country lights up on the map → next question
rules: each question is tied to one country from the geo pack
the country is shown only after the answer
social_hooks: a Group plays the same ten places and compares scores
questions about the countries a Group's members come from
content_needs: one question per place, with choices and the answer
the places named from the pack
example_prompts: finish the saying trivia with sayings from around the world, showing the country on a map once I answer
food trivia where the dish's country lights up on a map after each answer
festivals of the world quiz with a map
notes: Kevin's prompt #11. The game writes geo.places in question order and map_focus() = if locked then get_or(order, qi, -1) else -1. Places, outlines and coordinates come from the geo content pack (map_geometry, Natural Earth), never from Muse. Sayings and quotes must be traditional or original, not copyrighted text.
